title: wholesome rich energizing russian seafood grill
description: rich, dense, energizing russian dish featuring seafood stock, spherify, whole30-friendly, cooked on a binchotan grill.
instructions: soak binchotan grill wood chips in water for at least 30 minutes before cooking.
combine seafood stock, saffron, korean chili flakes, lemon juice, and ghee in a saucepan and bring to a simmer.
reduce heat to low and let simmer while cooking the seafood.
season pike fillets, octopus, and sea scallops with sea salt and black pepper.
grill the seafood on the preheated binchotan grill for 4-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
meanwhile, mix spherification sodium alginate and ice in a bowl and stir until the alginate is fully dissolved.
add water to the bowl and stir until the mixture is smooth.
use a syringe to drop the mixture into the simmering seafood stock and let spherify for 2-3 minutes.
garnish with fresh parsley and serve immediately.
serve the grilled seafood with the spherified seafood stock on the side.
drizzle with additional lemon juice if desired.
serve with your favorite sides, such as roasted vegetables or a salad.
